fato_historico: 1983: Thirty-eight IRA prisoners, armed with six handguns, hijack a prison meals lorry and smash their way out of the Maze Prison.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a gentle call to break free from self-imposed limitations. Much like finding a path where none seemed to exist, consider your own mental barriers. It is a good time to organize your thoughts, focus on precision, and trust that your diligent efforts will lead you toward a breakthrough of personal clarity and spiritual growth.
frase_do_dia: True liberation blooms when you align your daily actions with your deepest intentions.
significado_numero: Represents the collective strength found within individual focused determination.
conselho: Trust your analytical mind to navigate complex situations with grace and quiet confidence.
